idea-plugin.name: FloatBar
idea-plugin.description:
FloatBar adds a lightweight drawing overlay to JetBrains IDE editors.

Use it to sketch freehand notes, erase marks, fill bounded areas, draw basic shapes, toggle a grid, and keep quick visual annotations close to your code.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
• Added clearer FloatBar toolbar state and color feedback.
  • Improved overlay, grid, undo, redo, and clear-action polish.
  • Kept drawing, fill, erase, and shape behavior stable.

action.description: Show or hide the FloatBar drawing tools
